---
name: Question
about: Ask how the practice, a skill, or the bootstrap works
title: "[question] "
labels: ["question", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## What you're trying to do

A real goal, not a question about syntax. The point of asking is to unblock the
goal.

## What you've already tried

Links, file paths, commands. Don't make maintainers re-derive what you've
already tried.

## Where you got stuck

The exact line, error message, or decision point.

## Specific question

One sentence, answerable in a paragraph. If your question takes more than a
paragraph to ask, it is probably a feature request in disguise.
